name: KING CAESAR
about: New (PAD-658). The prayer at his pop bumper wakes him at the Mecha lane; four stages, each with its own shots named on the line (crack the shrine, absorb and reflect the beam, tag team with Godzilla, the final blow); cash the pot out at the right scoop after any stage. Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla (1974).

hud.line: POP BUMPERS, RIGHT RAMP AND MECHA LANE

do.text: POP BUMPERS, RIGHT RAMP AND MECHA LANE

then.text: HIT THE POP BUMPERS AND RIGHT RAMP

then.sub: NOW POP BUMPERS AND RIGHT RAMP

then.text: HIT THE POP BUMPERS AND MECHA LANE

ABSORB THE BEAM: SHOOT THE LEFT RAMP

then.text: SHOOT THE BUILDING: TEAR HIS HEAD OFF

intro.what: King Caesar rises out of the smoke and rubble of the burst mountainside, arms raised, as the dust clears around him, at 1:08:00.

loop.what: A calm wide shot of the Okinawa beach and blue sea with the tiny figure of the priestess praying at the water's edge, at 1:05:13.

crack.what: The beam from the statue strikes the seaside cliff, a starburst flares on the rock and the stone bursts open with flying debris, at 1:03:11.

awake.what: Close-up of the fully awake King Caesar roaring with glowing red eyes, his golden ears flaring up like flames, at 1:08:12.

absorb.what: Mechagodzilla fires its rainbow eye beam and the beam pours straight into King Caesar's glowing eye, at 1:08:49.

reflect.what: King Caesar's eye fires the rainbow beam back and it hits Mechagodzilla, who bursts in a blaze of sparks and smoke, at 1:08:41.

tagteam.what: Wide shot of King Caesar and Godzilla attacking Mechagodzilla together from both sides on the hilltop, at 1:19:38.

won.what: Godzilla wrenches Mechagodzilla's head, twists it off in a shower of sparks and the headless robot smokes, at 1:20:12.

lost.what: A dazed King Caesar staggers among the dark rocks after the missile barrage and topples over, at 1:13:29.

cashout.what: King Caesar lies back down in his mountain shrine, resting in the rock as the mist drifts past, at 1:22:41.

music.what: The film's brassy main title theme by Masaru Sato under the opening credits, no dialogue, at 0:01:31.

roar.what: King Caesar's shrill cry as he roars in close-up after waking, at 1:08:14.

crack.what: A rumbling blast as the beam cracks the seaside cliff and the stone breaks apart, at 1:03:11.

absorb.what: Mechagodzilla's warbling eye beam sound as it streams into King Caesar's eye, at 1:08:50.

reflect.what: The warbling beam fired back out of King Caesar's eye into a crackling impact on Mechagodzilla, at 1:08:42.

tagteam.what: Godzilla's falling roar in close-up as he squares up to Mechagodzilla, at 1:14:13.

won.what: A big rolling explosion as the alien base on the hilltop blows up, at 1:21:26.

lost.what: A pained low cry and thud as the dazed King Caesar reels among the rocks, at 1:13:31.

cashout.what: A single deep gong stroke ringing out and fading as the shrine statue on the roof begins to stir, at 1:02:55.
